manaNeeded: {1}{G} or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale if it has a +1/+1 counter on it
easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Basking Broodscale.
description:
If Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it, activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale using any other method.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token. 
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
